annotations.title: Pre-purchase check for any shop, checkout link, payment page, API or x402 endpoint — or for a need: find the offer and check it

description:
Before an agent buys or pays: send url (a shop, checkout or payment link, API or x402 endpoint) or need (what to buy, in plain words; Angel takes the pick from the open sea at mareliberum.dev and checks it, then the next offer if it fails). One unpaid request each: TLS, domain age, look-alikes, redirects, payment provider, card fields, text aimed at agents and, for x402, USDC contract, payTo and price traps. Verdict pay, caution or do_not_pay, risk_score, reasons. Free with a key (500 calls) or 5 calls a day without one; then 0.02 USDC per call via x402, or 1 call from a key.
After: input-guard on the page text you will act on (the result's next field has the exact call).

bundle_token.description: Your key instead of paying per call: free (500 calls, POST /key) or bought by card. The connection header X-Bundle-Token works too.

currency.description: with need: currency of the budget

need.description: instead of a url: what your user wants to buy, in plain words (sizes, budget, place included), e.g. "trail running shoes size 44 under 150 EUR, ships to Germany". Angel takes the pick from the open sea (mareliberum.dev/decide) and checks it before you pay.

partner_link.description: default true: on verdict pay for a shop with an affiliate program, the answer adds partner_link (same merchant, disclosed: Angel may earn a commission, merchant sets the price); false omits it

payer_address.description: Wallet you pay from (optional; the x402 price is the same for every address).

payment_tx.description: Hash of a USDC transfer on Base to payTo (≥ the price, ≤ 72 h old) instead of an x402 signature.

region.description: with need: country code or name

url.description: the shop, checkout or payment link, API or x402 endpoint to check (public https domain, port 443). Send url or need.
